title: Show HN: Putt.day a daily mini golf game
summary: Putt.day is a daily mini golf game where players complete a mini golf course each day, sharing scores and competing with friends in a format inspired by daily puzzle games like Wordle. The game was shared on Hacker News and gained significant community interest.
problem_solved: Provides a quick, accessible daily entertainment option with social sharing mechanics for the casual gaming market.
why_valuable: Taps into the successful 'daily ritual' game format that drives engagement through competition and shared experiences with friends.
